فتحنا متجرنا بعد أن تعبنا من منتجات لا ت.en: Lamaa began with one bag that went from work to errands to dinner and suited none of them. So we kept four families only, totes, crossbody bags, clutches and shoulder bags, and we try the zip and strap of every style before it is listed.
